name: Penny "Mallets" Okafor
fightingStyle: Fast and technical. Fights with two pairs of mallet sticks in rapid rolls and flurries, ringing out a hit for every note in a scale. Her combos run up and down like arpeggios.
personality: Bright, quick-talking and a bit of a perfectionist. Practices scales in the locker room before anyone else gets there and always knows exactly how many notes she just hit.
whyTheyFight: The pit stands on the sideline while everyone else marches, and Penny is tired of the front ensemble being called 'the furniture.' Winning Band Wars means the pit gets a real feature in the halftime show.
winQuote: Sixteen notes, sixteen hits. I counted.
ending: With the Golden Plume in hand, Penny writes a halftime feature where the pit is wheeled to the 50-yard line under the lights. The crowd hears every bar ring out across the field. The drumline admits, grudgingly, that 'the furniture' can play.
